m2a2_bradley.name: M2A2 Bradley
m2a2_bradley.authority: Release 269 (owner 2026-11-05, "the m3a2 bradley USA should be m2a2 bradley, and our current m2a2 bradley usa should be the m3a2 bradley"): the M2A2 is the shared Bradley hull (modern3.ts buildBradleyHull, measured from the owner's supplied model) under the classic turret (modern3.ts buildM2A2Bradley, profiles/bradleyClassicTurret.ts), rebuilt by builder T2 as an M2A2 ODS turret from the photographs below (commit 0f0c4793f7: welded body to a flat roof, cheeks to the gun bay, the ISU's armoured head, the stowed TOW launcher flush on the turret's left wall, the right-hand bin, the bustle basket, two whips at the rear corners). Release 270 (Main 2026-11-06: "The comparison registration follows the owner's swap. m3a2_bradley takes the source turret's model ... m2a2_bradley, now the classic turret, gets a classic-turret reference: a registered model if one exists, otherwise the photo-class route with a cited packet. Never score a build against a turret it no longer carries."): the 42manako print (m2_bradley_ifv.glb) is the source turret's model and is registered to the M3A2; no registered or owner-supplied model shows this turret (the owner's other Bradley models are M2A3/M3A3s), so the M2A2 proves this packet. docs/references/tanks/m2a2_bradley.md records the build and its sources.
m2a2_bradley.envelopeBasis: As built (Box3 at both qualities, the photo check's rule; 270, the 269 ODS classic turret). Width over the skirt course's grab handles (published 3.28 m over the base A2 hull, 3.6 m over the appliqué). Length from the ramp's tail-lamp guards to the bow's tow shackles (published 6.55 m hull). Tallest is the top of the two antenna whips on the turret's rear corners, as built rather than published; the turret roof stands at 2.98 m (published 2.97-2.98 m).
